overview_description.description:
We believe that the way business gets done today is broken. That’s why we’re dedicated to simplifying work for everyone - from small startups to large enterprise companies. Millions of individuals and over 60,000 companies world-wide trust the HelloSign platform – which includes eSignature, digital workflow and eFax solutions – to automate and manage their most important business transactions.

With a sharp focus on user experience and a lust for innovation, HelloSign is on a mission to Simplify Work.

about_short_description.short_description: HelloSign offers fast, secure, and legally binding eSignatures for businesses.

product.name: Dropbox Sign
product.description: A platform that allows users to send, sign, and track legally binding electronic signatures for documents, ensuring secure and efficient workflows.

product.name: Dropbox Sign API
product.description: An API that enables developers to integrate Dropbox Sign's eSignature functionality into their own applications, providing a seamless signing experience.

product.name: Templates
product.description: Reusable templates for frequently used documents, allowing for quick and consistent eSignature requests.

product.name: Bulk Send
product.description: A feature that allows users to send documents to multiple recipients at once, streamlining the process of collecting signatures from large groups.

product.name: Audit Trail
product.description: A feature that tracks and time-stamps every action taken on a document, providing a detailed history for legal and compliance purposes.

product.name: Embedded Signing
product.description: A feature that allows users to embed the signing process directly into their website or application, providing a seamless experience for signers.
